 Wat ga je doen? 
As a part-time mail carrier at PostNL in Horst, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. You can organise your own schedule, which makes this job very flexible. 
Your day starts at the depot in your neighbourhood, where you collect the mail for your route. You sort the letters and get your bike ready. Then you're ready to go! You cycle through the streets in your area and deliver mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you enjoy the fresh air and often have a chat with people you meet. 
This vacancy is for 3 hours per day from Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, which adds up to 9 hours per week. You can choose your own starting time, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the freedom to organise your work in the way that suits you best. 
Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy being outdoors? Apply now and start delivering letters and cards in one of our neighbourhoods in the region soon! 
Please note: the position is initially until the end of September. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at PostNL, the largest postal and parcel company in the Netherlands. Every day, they ensure that millions of letters and parcels are delivered to the right destination, both within the Netherlands and abroad. 
As a mail carrier, you work independently. You start your day by collecting the mail and have until 6:00 PM to sort and deliver everything. This allows you to largely determine your own pace and how you organise your day. 
The location is accessible from Venray, Horst, America, Hegelsom, Meterik, Sevenum, Melderslo and Grubbenvorst. Do you live in one of these places? If so, you may even be able to cycle to the depot. Do you enjoy working independently outdoors and making people happy with their mail? Then this is the perfect job for you!

Are you passionate about electronics, testing and automation, and eager to make a direct impact on the quality and manufacturability of high-tech products? Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).

27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT). Hier kom je te werken Through their unwavering commitment to excellence, this company strives to create technologies that make the world
